GENERATED by tools/skills/emit_abilities.py from design/data-drafts/skills/*.json - edit the drafts (or tools/skills/skill_tables.py) and re-run; do not hand-edit. GENERATED (2026-10-22 build): every affinity's drafted skills are here. New keys: base_rune and signature (the rune the skill is built on, and the fields its nature lives in); starter; draft_kind where the draft named a kind the game builds as another (hex, smite, seize and gaze are kind 'smite': an instant effect on the targeted enemy); magnitude (self buffs and channels: the fields a rune's power op scales, as an amount or as a multiplier's gap from 1); simplified (what the game does not build yet; the summary says '(simplified)'); good_modifiers (the draft's). New kinds: smite, channel (held: cost is per second, a payload every 'tick' along 'shape' line | cone | nearest | tether | self), charge_release (hold up to charge_max, release as 'release'), summon (a thrall from a corpse), seed (hidden, triggered), grapple (moved to a point), streak (through bodies in one step), field_pulse (acts on your corpses or growth). A hit payload may also carry: status_s (how long its status lasts), status_data, consume, consume_stacks, bonus_flat_vs, poise_vs, through (ignores front block and shields), jumps (arcs on to more enemies), execute_below, unliving_mult, stun_per_mark, turn_s, needs_facing, release_shove, hard_interrupt, interrupts_moving.

water_bolt.name: Water Bolt
water_bolt.summary: First enemy hit is Soaked and knocked back a step.

tsunami_strike.name: Breaker
tsunami_strike.summary: A wide blow that throws everyone it hits 4 m away from you. Stand so the wall is behind them.

hydraulic_flex.name: Sluice Step
hydraulic_flex.summary: A short dash straight through enemies. Each one you pass is Soaked and swept 2 m along with you, the way you are going.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.verse: The floor of the room leans.
undertow.summary: Point, 9 m: every enemy within 4 m of the spot is dragged up to 4 m toward it and Soaked. No damage of its own - but bodies that collide Crush each other.

riptide_lash.name: Riptide Lash
riptide_lash.verse: A rope of water for one throat.
riptide_lash.summary: One enemy within 10 m is hauled to arm's length, takes 60, is Soaked and interrupted - and arrives with its back to you for a second.

standing_pool.name: Standing Pool
standing_pool.verse: A tide that forgot to leave.
standing_pool.summary: Point, 9 m: a pool 3.5 m across for 8 s. Enemies in it are Soaked and 30% slower, and a shove that starts in it goes twice as far. No damage.

backwash.name: Backwash
backwash.verse: Let it hit the water instead.
backwash.summary: 6 s or three blows, whichever ends first: each melee hit on you is halved, and the water splashes off you - whoever threw the blow, and everyone else within 2 m of you, is shoved 3 m and Soaked.

pressure_jet.name: Pressure Jet
pressure_jet.simplified: your turning is not slowed, and there is no extra damage against a wall
pressure_jet.summary: Hold: an 8 m stream, 1 m wide, at the first enemy in the line: 90 damage a second and it is pushed back 5 m a second. Pinned against a wall or stone it takes 1.5x. You turn slowly and walk at 45% while holding. 10 essence a second. (simplified)

drawdown.name: Drawdown
drawdown.simplified: it does not empty your Standing Pool toward you
drawdown.summary: Every Soaked enemy within 8 m has the water torn out of it toward you: its Soak ends and it is dragged 3 m toward you. You get 2 essence back for each. Your Standing Pool in range empties toward you too, dragging those in it twice as far, and is gone. (simplified)

drench.name: Drench
drench.summary: Point, 10 m: a cloudburst gathers for 0.6 s, then falls on a 3 m circle. Everyone under it is Waterlogged for 6 s and interrupted. A Waterlogged heavy enemy is shoved as if it were light, and an elite as if it were heavy.

wringing_grip.name: Wringing Grip
wringing_grip.summary: One enemy within reach: you grip it and wring the water out. A 1.6x blow, +90 if it was Soaked (+180 if Waterlogged) - the grip uses the Soak up - and it reels back 1 m. Little more than a slap on a dry target.

upwelling.name: Upwelling
upwelling.summary: Point, 9 m: a spring bursts up under everyone within 2.5 m. 30 damage; light enemies are lifted Aloft and come down 2 m out from the spring (4 m, since Aloft doubles a shove). Heavy enemies lose 50 poise and slide 1 m.

drowning_hold.name: Drowning Hold
drowning_hold.summary: One enemy within 8 m: a ball of water closes over its head for 3 s. It is interrupted, cannot attack, cast, drum or call for help, and takes 20 at once and 15 a second. When the water lets go it heaves the enemy 3 m away from you, so put the wall behind it first.

steady_drip.name: Steady Drip
steady_drip.summary: Cheap. One enemy within 10 m drips for 10 s: every second it is nudged half a step away from you and loses 8 poise, and its poise does not recover while it drips. Leave it on a big enemy and it staggers on its own.

siltfall.name: Siltfall
siltfall.summary: Everything you moved settles. Every enemy within 10 m that a water skill shoved or dragged in the last 1.5 s sinks where it now stands: Pinned (60% slower) for 2 s and 30 poise. Bodies still sliding finish their slide first.

seepage.name: Seepage
seepage.summary: One enemy within 9 m: water soaks in under its guard for 0.6 s, then wells up behind it - 50 damage that ignores its shield and armour, and a 1.5 m tug toward you. For 4 s its shield and armour count for nothing, against anyone.

tidal_bore.name: Tidal Bore
tidal_bore.simplified: the wave does not carry bodies along; it hits each once
tidal_bore.summary: Dear. A wall of water 5 m wide rolls 12 m forward from you. Everyone it meets is picked up and carried to where it breaks: 45 damage, Soaked, 30 poise. If it breaks against a wall, everyone it carries is Crushed. Heavy enemies are dropped halfway; elites split it. (simplified)

slack_water.name: Slack Water
slack_water.summary: The tide stops to turn. Everything within 4.5 m is interrupted and hangs still for 2 s (60% slower), and the next shove or drag on each of them goes twice as far. Your water reflux drops by 20. No damage.

kiln_fist.name: Kiln Fist
kiln_fist.verse: Fire the hand like clay. Then find out what it breaks.
kiln_fist.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Alight, interrupts. If it was already burning, every stack is spent for +40 and the blow bursts, lighting those beside it.

cinder_spit.name: Cinder Spit
cinder_spit.verse: A coal from the mouth. It was never going to stay in.
cinder_spit.summary: A quick, cheap bolt that sets its target Alight. Weak cold; it is how you get hot.

flashover.name: Flashover
flashover.verse: The room does not burn slowly. Neither do you.
flashover.summary: A short dash that leaves a line of flame for 3 s: anything standing in it catches. It does not carry you through enemies.

pyre_call.name: Pyre Call
pyre_call.summary: Every Alight enemy within 10 m loses its stacks, and each stack bursts for 35 in 2 m. Spread the burns first; call them once.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.summary: Open the door. First every enemy within 5 m is drawn 2 m toward you, then the blast: they take 4 x the heat you carry above 20, and your fire reflux drops to 20. 320 at full heat; nothing when cold.

bellows_breath.name: Bellows Breath
bellows_breath.summary: Hold: a cone of fire 5 m long and 60 degrees wide. 50 damage a second and 1 Alight every half second to everything in it. You walk at 45% while holding. 6 essence a second, and every second of it heats you - the fastest way to get hot.

stoke.name: Stoke
stoke.verse: Feed it. It was going to eat anyway.
stoke.summary: At once, +25 heat. For 6 s every bare strike you land sets its target Alight. Light a man with your hands, then Kiln Fist him.

slag_pool.name: Slag Pool
slag_pool.verse: The floor remembers being a furnace.
slag_pool.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: 3 m across for 6 s. 25 a second and 1 Alight a second to enemies standing in it.

hiss.name: Hiss
hiss.summary: One burning enemy within 9 m: every Alight stack on it goes out at once and it takes 48 per stack, all now - what the burn would still have done, and a little more. Your fire reflux drops 6 per stack. Five stacks: 240 damage and 30 heat off. Leaves no reflux of its own.

wickpinch.name: Wickpinch
wickpinch.summary: Costs no essence: it burns 15 of your heat instead, and cannot be cast below 15. One enemy within 7 m has its flame pinched out: whatever it was doing is interrupted - even an attack that is not marked as interruptible - and it loses 40 poise. A Censer-Bearer snuffed this way no longer bursts when it dies.

flashpan.name: Flashpan
flashpan.summary: A flash of flame from your hands across a 90-degree cone 6 m deep. 30 damage, and everyone in it that is facing you is Blinded: it cannot aim and its blows miss you, for 1 s plus 1 s for every 30 heat you carry (up to 4 s). Archers lose their aim. Enemies with their backs to you are not blinded.

smokepall.name: Smokepall
smokepall.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: a pall of smoke 3 m across. Enemies in it are Slowed, ranged enemies cannot see into or through it, and Alight burns on enemies inside do not run down. Lasts 4 s, plus 1 s for every 20 heat you carry (up to 9 s).

slingstone.name: Slingstone
slingstone.verse: A stone has all the time there is. Lend it yours.
slingstone.summary: The slowest bolt and the heaviest. It stops what it hits mid-swing and all but staggers it. Thrown into your own stone, it shatters it.

landslide_blow.name: Landslide Blow
landslide_blow.verse: The hill does not swing. It simply stops holding on.
landslide_blow.summary: A narrow, slow, crushing blow: it staggers anything short of an elite, moves nobody, and shatters every stone of yours in its arc.

raise_slab.name: Raise Slab
raise_slab.verse: Ask the floor to stand up. It remembers how.
raise_slab.summary: A wall of stone across your aim, up to 8 m away. It blocks movement and shots - theirs and yours - for 12 s. Three at a time.

pillar.name: Pillar
pillar.verse: The ground has an opinion about where they are standing.
pillar.summary: Point, 9 m: a circle is marked for half a second, then a column punches up - 120, 60 poise, interrupts - and stays as stone.

stonehide.name: Stonehide
stonehide.verse: Decide to be somewhere, and be there.
stonehide.summary: 8 s Braced: 40% less damage, and nothing staggers or shoves you. You move 25% slower.

bedrock_shove.name: Bedrock Shove
bedrock_shove.verse: Put your shoulder where the mountain keeps its own.
bedrock_shove.summary: Shoulder first, 3.5 m, Braced throughout. The first enemy you meet is thrown 3 m and loses 50 poise; a heavy one stops you dead and loses 60.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.verse: Everything standing is standing on your say-so.
tremor.summary: Everything within 5 m takes 60, is interrupted and slowed for 3 s - and every stone you have standing shatters outward at once.

quarry_throw.name: Quarry Throw
quarry_throw.simplified: the rubble left behind does not slow anyone
quarry_throw.summary: Hold to tear a boulder out of the floor (rooted and Braced, up to 1.5 s), release to lob it at the cursor, up to 14 m. 150 to 400 damage in 2.5 m by how long you held, 80 poise, and it leaves rubble: a stone that also slows enemies within 2 m of it by 40%. (simplified)

sinkhole.name: Sinkhole
sinkhole.simplified: a mire zone, not a pit: enemies are not trapped, do not path round it, and it is not one of your stones
sinkhole.summary: Point, 9 m, 0.5 s wind-up (Braced): the floor drops into a pit 2.5 m across for 10 s. Enemies standing there fall in for 30 damage and 40 poise. Inside they are Mired and need 1.5 s to climb out; enemies walk round it, and shots fly over it. It counts as one of your three stones. (simplified)

cairn.name: Cairn
cairn.simplified: the target is held and takes a quarter of hits instead of the cairn taking them; breaking it does nothing extra
cairn.summary: One enemy within 8 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): earth heaps over it. It is Buried for 2.5 s - it cannot move or act, and blows land on the stone, not on it. Shatter the cairn (Slingstone, Landslide Blow, Tremor) and the one inside takes 120 and is Staggered. Elites are Pinned instead. The cairn counts as one of your three stones. (simplified)

burrow.name: Burrow
burrow.simplified: it passes through bodies but not under stone or shots
burrow.summary: 0.3 s wind-up (Braced), then you go under the floor and come up 6 m on, 0.4 s later, passing beneath enemies, stone and shots (a slam on the ground can still find you). Where you surface the ground heaves: enemies within 1.5 m lose 40 poise and are pushed 1.5 m off. Surface beside your own stone and it shatters away from you. (simplified)

cave_in.name: Cave-In
cave_in.simplified: the rubble is a stone block: it also stops shots
cave_in.summary: Dear. Point, 10 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): rock comes down on a 3 m circle a full second later. Everything still under it takes 130 and 70 poise and is Stunned for 1 s, elites included. The rubble stays for 15 s: nothing can walk through it, but shots pass over. It counts as one of your three stones. (simplified)

cutting_gust.name: Cutting Gust
cutting_gust.verse: Air has an edge. Most people never find it.
cutting_gust.summary: A short gust that passes through everything in its line. Spends up to 3 pips for +15 each - weak from a standstill.

crosscut.name: Crosscut
crosscut.verse: Do not meet them. Pass through where they were looking.
crosscut.summary: One enemy within 7 m: you cut through and stop behind it. Always a hit from behind. Spends every pip for +10% each.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.verse: Something behind you agrees you should leave.
tailwind.summary: The longest dash, +3 pips, and the only one with no recovery: you can strike or cast the instant it ends.

downdraft.name: Downdraft
downdraft.summary: Point, 8 m, 4 m wide: 50, interrupts, pins enemies for 2 s, knocks their shots out of the air, and does +100 to anything Aloft.

updraft.name: Updraft
updraft.verse: What goes up is yours until it comes down.
updraft.summary: Point, 8 m: enemies within 2.5 m are thrown Aloft for 1.2 s (+0.2 s a pip, up to 4) - helpless, and taking 25% more. Heavy ones lose poise instead.

veil.name: Crosswind Veil
veil.verse: Nothing thrown at you arrives where you are.
veil.summary: 5 s: enemy shots aimed at you curve away and miss, and your Slipstream does not drain. Blades still land.

gale_lane.name: Gale Lane
gale_lane.verse: A road only you can run.
gale_lane.summary: A lane 10 m long from your feet, 6 s. In it you move 40% faster and gain pips twice as fast; enemies are pushed down it.

spindrift.name: Spindrift
spindrift.summary: Hold while you run: you keep full speed, and every 0.25 s the nearest enemy within 3 m takes 25 (with Lee if you are behind it). Costs 6 essence a second and 1 pip every half second; ends when the pips run out.

dead_air.name: Dead Air
dead_air.summary: Spend every pip: a 4 m bubble of still air where you stand, lasting 1 s plus 1 s per pip spent. Enemy shots that enter it drop to the floor, your pips do not drain, and your wind reflux sheds while you stand in it. Step out and it ends. Cast from a standstill it is one breath long.

headwind.name: Headwind
headwind.summary: A wall of wind in front of you, a 70-degree cone 6.5 m long: 20 damage, enemies in it are Slowed for 3 s, a charge or pounce in it stops dead, and you take 1 pip from each enemy caught (up to 4). The one wind skill that pays you for standing your ground.

dust_devil.name: Dust Devil
dust_devil.summary: Point, 9 m: a whirlwind 3 m across that drags enemies toward its middle and cuts them for 15 every half second. It drifts at walking pace the way you were running when you cast it, taking them along. Lasts 1.5 s, plus 1 s per pip spent (up to 4).

blowout.name: Blowout
blowout.summary: Everything within 4.5 m is blown apart: 30 damage and thrown 2 m outward, and each one lands facing away from you for 1 s, so your next hit is from behind. Spends up to 4 pips: +0.5 m and +10 damage each. It also blows smoke and gas away and knocks shots in flight out of the ring.

plumb_bolt.name: Plumb Bolt
plumb_bolt.summary: One enemy within 14 m is struck from straight above: 100 damage, 30 poise and a Live mark. Bodies, shields and low walls between you do not stop it.

ground_rod.name: Ground Rod
ground_rod.verse: Give the sky a second place to land.
ground_rod.summary: Point, 8 m: a rod for 10 s that blocks nothing. Each lightning skill you cast within 8 m of it also arcs from the rod to the nearest enemy within 5 m: 40 and a mark. One rod at a time.

static_coat.name: Static Coat
static_coat.verse: Touch me and learn what I am carrying.
static_coat.summary: 6 s: an enemy that hits you in melee takes 25 and a Live mark, and every second bare strike you land adds a mark.

stored_bolt.name: Stored Bolt
stored_bolt.summary: Hold up to 1.2 s, walking slowly; let go for an instant line 12 m long through everything: 100 to 300 damage and 1 to 3 Live marks by how long you held. A full charge Overloads the whole line.

dead_short.name: Dead Short
dead_short.verse: Everything you have marked, all at once, for less.
dead_short.summary: Every marked enemy within 12 m Overloads now: 40% of the full blow and stun at 1 mark, 70% at 2, all of it at 3. It grounds no reflux.

arc_lash.name: Arc Lash
arc_lash.verse: It was there and now it is here.
arc_lash.summary: Instant and short: it cannot miss what it points at. 85 damage and a Live mark, then it arcs to one more enemy within 4 m for the same. Walls stop it.

forked_path.name: Forked Path
forked_path.verse: It does not choose. It takes every road.
forked_path.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then up to three more within 5 m of each other: 50 and 1 Live mark each. Never the same body twice.

bell_jar.name: Bell Jar
bell_jar.simplified: Overload arcs are not kept inside the jar
bell_jar.summary: One enemy within 12 m is sealed under a jar of still air for 6 s: 30 damage and a Live mark. Nothing passes in or out of it: no auras, no death burst, no arcs. Overload it and the whole arc stays inside: +60 for every other marked enemy within 12 m. (simplified)

stepped_leader.name: Stepped Leader
stepped_leader.verse: Find the path first. Then take all of it at once.
stepped_leader.summary: You are simply there, up to 6 m away: over enemies and gaps, not through walls or stone. A Live mark on everything beside where you land, and you are Quickened for 2 s after.

seize_up.name: Seize Up
seize_up.summary: Everything within 3 m locks up: 30 damage, and Stunned for 0.4 s for every Live mark it carries (0.2 s if none). It spends no marks.

thunderclap_palm.name: Thunderclap Palm
thunderclap_palm.verse: The sound arrives after the damage, to apologise.
thunderclap_palm.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Live marks, and it stops whatever it was doing. The crack Dazes and staggers everyone within 2.5 m of it, the target too.

dead_line.name: Dead Line
dead_line.summary: Point, 9 m: a ring 3 m across hums for 6 s. Enemies inside cannot cast, drum or call for help. Each is interrupted and takes a Live mark once, on entering.

set_solid.name: Set Solid
set_solid.summary: The air around you sets. Everything within 3.5 m takes 30 damage and 3 Chill: two more and it freezes solid.

false_spring.name: False Spring
false_spring.simplified: a thawed body does not keep the two Chill that Frozen leaves
false_spring.summary: Every Frozen enemy within 10 m thaws at once, and the cold it held pours out: 50 damage and 3 Chill to every other enemy within 3 m of it. It frees what you froze, to freeze the ones beside it. (simplified)

hoarline.name: Hoarline
hoarline.summary: A line of frost races 10 m along the ground: 45 damage and 2 Chill to everything on it. The line stays frosted for 4 s, adding a Chill a second to anyone standing on it. Walls stop it.

black_ice.name: Black Ice
black_ice.summary: Lay a strip of glaze 6 m ahead and slide the length of it. The glaze stays 5 s: you move 30% faster on it, and enemies standing on it keep slipping, losing poise every half second.

whiteout.name: Whiteout
whiteout.summary: Point, 10 m: snow falls over a circle 3.5 m across for 6 s. Enemies inside cannot see past 2 m (Blinded) and gain a Chill every second. Archers inside lose you.

runoff.name: Runoff
runoff.summary: An instant line 8 m long melts the cold out of everything on it: 25 damage plus 30 for every Chill it carried, and the Chill is gone. A Frozen one counts as 5 and is freed. All of them are left Soaked.

icicle.name: Icicle
icicle.summary: A spike of ice grown in your hand and thrown, slow and heavy: 80 damage, 45 poise and a Chill. It is a hard hit, so it Shatters anything Brittle or Frozen it reaches.

fracture.name: Fracture
fracture.summary: One enemy in reach: a hammer blow, 2.0x strike damage and 60 poise. If it is Frozen or Brittle it Shatters for +120 more, and the shards fly 4 m instead of 2.5.

craze.name: Craze
craze.summary: Point, 9 m: fine cracks race through a 3 m circle for half a second, then everything in it is Brittle for 5 s: its next hard hit Shatters it, frozen or not. The way to break what will not freeze.

ice_shell.name: Ice Shell
ice_shell.summary: A shell of ice closes over you for 8 s and takes the next 80 damage. When it breaks it bursts: 40 damage and 2 Chill to everything within 2.5 m.

blot.name: Blot
blot.summary: A blot of darkness, thrown: 60 damage, and where it lands the ground goes Dark in a circle 2.5 m across for 6 s. Hit them again while they stand in it.

daybreak.name: Daybreak
daybreak.summary: Every pool of your darkness within 12 m lifts at once. Each enemy standing in one is caught in the sudden light: Dazed for 1.5 s and Exposed for 4 s. You lose the dark you made.

pall.name: Pall
pall.summary: Point, 10 m: a pall of darkness 3.5 m across for 7 s. Nothing sees into it or through it: an aim from outside cannot pick out anything inside, and enemies inside are Blinded. It counts as Dark.

silhouette.name: Silhouette
silhouette.summary: One enemy within 12 m is outlined against the dark for 6 s: every hit on it counts as from behind (+30%, and a raised shield does not help). If it stands in Dark it is Blinded as well.

shadow_slip.name: Shadow Slip
shadow_slip.summary: Sink into the dark and rise from another shadow up to 10 m away: a Dark spot, or the shadow behind an enemy, which puts you at its back. Your first hit within 1 s counts as from behind. It cannot take you into the light.

shadownail.name: Shadownail
shadownail.summary: Point, 9 m: a black nail is driven into the shadows in a circle 1.5 m across. Whatever stands there after a quarter second takes 50 and is Shadowbound for 2.5 s (4 s in Dark): rooted where it stands, though it can still turn and swing.

muffle.name: Muffle
muffle.summary: For 6 s you make no sound. Striking no longer reveals you while you are Unseen, an enemy you hit that was not facing you takes +50%, and anything you kill raises no alarm.

knell.name: Knell
knell.summary: Point, 10 m: a tolling note rings over a circle 3 m across, three tolls 0.6 s apart, each 35 damage and 20 poise. In Dark the echo answers: two more tolls.

hungry_dark.name: Hungry Dark
hungry_dark.summary: The dark around you feeds. Everything within 3 m takes 1.6x strike damage; for each one hit you take back 2 essence (up to 4 hits) and swallow 1 light (up to 5). The ground under you goes Dark for 5 s, and any fire it touches goes out.

night_spill.name: Night Spill
night_spill.summary: Let out what the dark swallowed: a cone 6 m long. 30 damage, plus 30 for every light swallowed, to everything in it, and the ground it covers goes Dark for 5 s. At 3 or more they are Dazed.

iron_slug.name: Iron Slug
iron_slug.summary: You hammer a slug out of the iron you carry and hurl it: 70 damage and 35 poise. Like every metal hit it ignores a raised shield and hits plate hardest: 105 on a plated enemy.

rust_bloom.name: Rust Bloom
rust_bloom.summary: Point, 9 m: rust blooms over a circle 3.5 m across for 7 s. Anything inside that wears metal is Rusting: 6 damage a second per metal class, and its front armour is halved. Bare skin does not care.

spot_weld.name: Spot Weld
spot_weld.simplified: the two are not tethered together; both are only slowed
spot_weld.summary: One enemy within 9 m and the nearest other within 4 m of it are welded together for 5 s: 45 damage each, neither can move more than 4 m from the other, and both are 40% slower. A lone one is welded to the floor instead. Each metal class adds 1 s. (simplified)

splitting_blow.name: Splitting Blow
splitting_blow.summary: A cleaving blow across 120 degrees: 1.8x strike damage and 50 poise. Every armoured enemy it hits has its metal split open, and the pieces fly on behind it: 30 per metal class to everyone within 2.5 m.

iron_clasp.name: Iron Clasp
iron_clasp.summary: One enemy within 9 m: a band of iron snaps shut round its arms. 25 damage, interrupted, and Shackled for 2.5 s: it can still walk, but cannot attack. Each metal class it wears adds 1 s.

breakthrough.name: Breakthrough
breakthrough.summary: Drive forward 5 m, point first. A bare enemy in the way stops you and is knocked back 1.5 m. One that wears metal is punched through: 40 damage, you carry on past it, and it is Stripped for 4 s.

whetted_cut.name: Whetted Cut
whetted_cut.summary: Hold to draw your weapon's edge keen, up to 1.5 s, walking at 45%. Let go for one cut across 60 degrees and 3.3 m: 1.6x strike damage at a tap, up to 3.2x at a full hold.

turn_the_edge.name: Turn the Edge
turn_the_edge.summary: A ringing sweep that blunts every edge near you: everything within 3.5 m takes 1.6x strike damage and 40 poise, and is Dulled for 6 s: its blows do 35% less and cannot stagger you.

plating.name: Plating
plating.summary: For 8 s the metal you wear thickens: every blow on you does 25% less, and a blade that lands on you is Dulled for 3 s. You move 10% slower.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.summary: One enemy in reach: you get a grip on its armour and wrench it off. 1.6x strike damage, interrupted, and Stripped for 8 s: no front armour, and it takes 20% more from everything. It no longer counts as armoured, so metal loses its own bonus on it.

red_lancet.name: Red Lancet
red_lancet.summary: A thin blade of essence thrown along your aim. The first enemy it hits takes 50 and starts Bleeding (2 stacks).

tourniquet.name: Tourniquet
tourniquet.summary: For 6 s no blow opens a wound on you: each one that would have spends 2 held blood instead. The blow still takes health from the bar; with too little held blood, the wound opens as usual.

deep_draught.name: Deep Draught
deep_draught.summary: Hold for up to 4 s: every half second, one Bleeding stack is drawn out of each bleeding enemy within 5 m (12 damage each) and one blood pool in reach is drunk. Each stack or pool becomes 1 held blood. You walk at 60%.

outpour.name: Outpour
outpour.summary: Pour every measure of held blood out in a cone 6 m long: 30 damage plus 18 for each measure spent (210 with all ten), 1 Bleeding, and the floor where it lands runs with fresh pools. With no held blood it does 30.

clotblade.name: Clotblade
clotblade.summary: A wide sweep with blades of hardened blood: 1.8x strike damage in front of you. Every Bleeding stack on a target it hits sets hard in the cut for +22 damage and +12 poise damage, and those stacks are spent.

thinblood_rush.name: Thinblood Rush
thinblood_rush.summary: A fast 4.8 m dash that slips between bodies. Every blood pool you cross carries you 1.5 m further (up to +3 m), and you move 20% faster for 2 s after.

hammering_heart.name: Hammering Heart
hammering_heart.summary: Every Bleeding enemy within 10 m feels its heart hammer three times in 1.5 s. Each beat does 8 for every Bleeding stack it carries and throws a blood pool on the floor. The stacks are not spent.

heavy_heart.name: Heavy Heart
heavy_heart.simplified: blood pools in the circle do not go still
heavy_heart.summary: Point, 9 m: a 3 m circle for 6 s where hearts slow. Enemies in it are Sluggish: 30% slower, and their attacks take half again as long to wind up. Every blood pool the circle touches goes still too and does the same for its 6 s. (simplified)

gullet_knot.name: Gullet Knot
gullet_knot.summary: One enemy within 10 m: its own blood knots in its throat. 30 damage and interrupted. If it is Bleeding it is Choked for 2.5 s (1 s if not): it cannot attack, shoot, cast or call for help, and walks at half speed.

long_breath.name: Long Breath
long_breath.summary: Breathe out up to 4 held blood: each takes 6 off your hottest reflux at once. Then for 6 s your poise is refilled and doubled, and reflux sheds twice as fast.

knit.name: Knit
knit.summary: For 6 s you regain 5 health a second. It fills the bar only up to the ceiling your wounds allow; once the bar is full, what is left seeps into your oldest wound at a quarter of the rate. A blow does not break it.

withering_needle.name: Withering Needle
withering_needle.summary: A needle of life turned inward. The first enemy hit takes 45 and 1 Withering (7 a second for 6 s, up to 3 stacks), straight past shields and armour. It does nothing to constructs or the dead.

fresh_stride.name: Fresh Stride
fresh_stride.summary: A 5.2 m dash on renewed legs. It never leaves you Winded, and it clears Winded if you are, so the dash after it costs the normal price. You move 15% faster for 3 s after. It stops at bodies.

wearying_sweep.name: Wearying Sweep
wearying_sweep.summary: Everything within 3 m of you takes 1.7x strike damage and is Spent for 4 s: it moves 25% and attacks 30% slower. Enemies above half health take 25% more.

corded_muscle.name: Corded Muscle
corded_muscle.summary: For 7 s your muscles thicken: bare strikes do 40% more damage and 50% more poise damage, and heavy blows take only half as much of your own poise.

wasting_grip.name: Wasting Grip
wasting_grip.summary: One enemy in reach: a grip that wastes the body under it. 2.0x strike damage, and for 6 s it is Wasted: its blows do 30% less and its poise is cut to 60%, so it staggers sooner. Open a Brute with it.

fever_break.name: Fever Break
fever_break.simplified: the player carries no enemy statuses yet: it clears stagger, Winded and a shove
fever_break.summary: At once, ends every harmful thing on you: stagger, Winded, burning, slows and holds, sickness and poison. For 5 s after, new ones last half as long. (simplified)

turn_the_stomach.name: Turn the Stomach
turn_the_stomach.summary: One living enemy within 9 m is Sick for 8 s: every 2.5 s it retches, loses whatever it was doing and stands still for half a second. 20 damage.

regrowth.name: Regrowth
regrowth.summary: Hold, standing still, for up to 8 s: 1.5 points a second go into your oldest wound until it closes and gives its share of the bar back, then into the next. A lost arm mends too, at half the rate, which rest never does. Any blow breaks it.

unmending.name: Unmending
unmending.summary: Point, 9 m: after 0.4 s everything living within 3 m takes 30 and is Arrested for 8 s. It cannot heal or get its poise back, and the Life statuses on it stop running down. Cast it on the pack before the Censer-Bearer falls.

endstroke.name: Endstroke
endstroke.summary: One enemy in reach: 2.0x strike damage, 30% more if it is Dying (below half). Anything short of an elite left under 15% of its health dies outright.

last_mercy.name: Last Mercy
last_mercy.summary: One enemy within 10 m is Spared for 4 s: nothing can take it below 1 health. If it is already below half, it kneels and does nothing. Hold a Censer-Bearer at the edge until it is clear of its friends.

rise_again.name: Rise Again
rise_again.summary: Point at a corpse within 10 m: it gets up and fights for you for 15 s, with 120 health, hitting the nearest enemy for 15 a blow. Two at a time. Without a corpse nothing happens and nothing is spent.

lay_to_rest.name: Lay to Rest
lay_to_rest.summary: Every corpse within 6 m of you (up to 4) goes into the ground for good. Each gives you back 5 essence and takes 8 off your death reflux, and the ground drags down the enemies standing next to it: 40 poise damage and interrupted.

rotting_bolt.name: Rotting Bolt
rotting_bolt.summary: A clot of decay thrown along your aim: 50 and Rotting for 6 s (its armour and shield count for half, and lost poise does not come back). If it hits a corpse instead, the corpse bursts: 60 and Rotting to everything within 2.5 m.

embalm.name: Embalm
embalm.summary: For 5 s you cannot die: your health stops at 1, though blows that land still open wounds as usual. You heal nothing while it lasts.

lingering_shade.name: Lingering Shade
lingering_shade.summary: Point at a corpse within 10 m, or where something died in the last 10 s: its shade lingers there for 8 s in a 3 m circle. Enemies inside take 15 a second and are Dreading: they back out and will not walk in. The corpse is left for other uses.

banishing_line.name: Banishing Line
banishing_line.summary: An instant line 10 m long through everything: 55, 20 poise damage, and interrupts. Constructs, spirits and anything animated take triple.

gravestep.name: Gravestep
gravestep.summary: You pass out of sight and step out up to 6 m away, or up to 12 m away onto a corpse. Every enemy that was aiming at you loses its aim.

death_mask.name: Death Mask
death_mask.summary: Point, 8 m: a likeness of you takes form out of grave-dust. For 5 s every enemy within 6 m turns on it instead of you. When it breaks or its time runs out, it falls apart: 40 to everything within 3 m.

heartwood.name: Heartwood
heartwood.summary: Point, 8 m: a sapling bursts up into a tree trunk in 0.6 s, shoving anyone standing there aside for 25. It blocks walking and shots for 30 s, gets tougher every second it stands, and every 5 s spreads a bramble patch at its foot. One at a time.

dwindling_gall.name: Dwindling Gall
dwindling_gall.summary: A gall-vine takes root in one enemy within 9 m and shrinks it for 8 s: 20 damage, it counts one weight class lighter (shoves move it, Aloft lifts it), and its reach is cut by 30%. When it dies, the gall falls and grows a bramble patch.

thornburst.name: Thornburst
thornburst.summary: Point, 9 m: after 0.35 s thorns burst up from the ground. 60 and Slowed to everything within 1.5 m, and the thorns stay as a bramble patch that spreads and thickens the longer it stands.

sere_ground.name: Sere Ground
sere_ground.summary: Point, 10 m: every patch of your growth within 4 m dies at once, and everything standing in one takes 30 (45 if the patch was grown, 60 if in bloom). The ground is clear again.

greening.name: Greening
greening.summary: Every patch of your growth within 12 m grows one age at once and puts out a new patch, and for 6 s all of it works 50% harder.

heartrot.name: Heartrot
heartrot.summary: One enemy within 9 m, then two more within 5 m of each other: 40 each and Blighted for 8 s. The wood they carry rots: shields stop half as much and bows take half again as long to aim, and Nature hits them 20% harder.

reaping_sweep.name: Reaping Sweep
reaping_sweep.summary: A wide scything sweep through 180 degrees: 1.8x strike damage. Each patch of your growth in the arc is cut back to a sprout and adds 15% to the blow (up to 60%) and 1 essence to you; the roots stay and regrow.

scatter_seed.name: Scatter Seed
scatter_seed.summary: Throw five seeds over a 2.5 m spread at a point within 9 m. Each lies hidden until an enemy steps on it (or for 6 s), then bursts up: 35 damage and Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch that stays and spreads.

vine_reach.name: Vine Reach
vine_reach.summary: A vine lashes out to a point within 9 m and hauls you there. Enemies within 1.5 m of where you land are Rooted for 1 s, and a snarevine patch takes root on the spot.

unwinding.name: Unwinding
unwinding.summary: Every enemy your vines are holding within 10 m is let go at once and whipped 3 m away from you, for 40 (and a Crush if it hits something). Anything holding you lets go too.

dayline.name: Dayline
dayline.summary: An instant line of daylight, 16 m: the first thing on it takes 60 and is Lit for 6 s. Walls, stone and a raised shield stop it.

dusk_well.name: Dusk Well
dusk_well.summary: Point, 10 m: a pool of dusk 4 m across for 7 s. Nothing outside can see or shoot into it, and nothing inside can see out. Lit enemies stay in plain view.

glint.name: Glint
glint.summary: You are a streak of light: up to 7 m along your aim in an instant, through enemies, lighting each one you pass. A wall, stone or a raised shield stops you short.

still_lamp.name: Still Lamp
still_lamp.summary: Point, 9 m: hang a steady lamp for 12 s. Every enemy within 5 m of it is Lit while it stays: it cannot hide and its armour's gaps show. One lamp at a time; it blocks nothing.

noonburst.name: Noonburst
noonburst.summary: Light and heat pour out of you: everything within 3.5 m with a clear line to you takes a heavy hit and is Lit. A raised shield shades whoever holds it.

gathered_light.name: Gathered Light
gathered_light.summary: Every Lit enemy within 12 m that has a clear line to you gives its light back: it takes 60 and loses Lit, and the ray coming home hits everything between it and you for 40.

hard_glare.name: Hard Glare
hard_glare.summary: A cone of hard light, 8 m long: everything in it takes 20 and is Blinded for 3 s. Archers lose their aim; others only swing at what is right in front of them.

clear_eye.name: Clear Eye
clear_eye.summary: For 6 s you see every gap: each enemy within 15 m is Lit at once, and your hits on Lit enemies ignore front armour completely.

glancing_ray.name: Glancing Ray
glancing_ray.simplified: it glances off walls and stone, not off raised shields
glancing_ray.summary: A ray that glances off walls, stone and raised shields up to twice, 14 m in all, hitting the first body on each leg for 55 and lighting it. Bank it off a wall to reach the back of a shield line. (simplified)

bent_light.name: Bent Light
bent_light.summary: For 5 s the light bends round you: nothing more than 3 m away can see you, so archers cannot aim and the pack loses you. Your first hit out of it counts as from behind, and ends it.

dozing_mote.name: Dozing Mote
dozing_mote.summary: A slow, drifting mote: 45, and the target nods. The first mote Dazes it; a second on a Dazed target puts it to sleep for 4 s. It must see the mote coming.

rousing_blow.name: Rousing Blow
rousing_blow.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow. On a sleeper it is a rude waking: double damage and 80 poise, enough to stagger most.

doubling_step.name: Doubling Step

leave_decoy.fools: enemies that see you as you cast

doubling_step.summary: Step 5 m aside and leave a phantom of yourself behind for 3 s. Enemies that were watching you go for the phantom instead; it breaks at the first blow.

shattered_dream.name: Shattered Dream
shattered_dream.summary: Every enemy within 10 m under one of your Dream spells wakes from it at once: 50 each, 100 to sleepers, and all of them are Dazed for 2 s. Your phantoms burst for 40.

night_terror.name: Night Terror
night_terror.summary: For a moment you are the thing under the bed: everything within 4 m that sees you takes a blow and is Terrified for 2 s - it turns, runs, and will not attack.

quiet_hour.name: Quiet Hour
quiet_hour.summary: Point, 9 m: a hush 3.5 m across for 7 s. Enemies in it that see it are Soothed: they move 30% slower and start no attacks. Hitting one snaps it out.

changeling_mask.name: Changeling Mask
changeling_mask.simplified: its friends attack the masked one, but it does not fight back
changeling_mask.summary: One enemy within 10 m that sees you wears your face for 4 s. Its friends within 8 m that see it take it for you and attack it, and it fights back. (simplified)

read_the_tell.name: Read the Tell
read_the_tell.summary: One enemy within 12 m that sees you shows its hand for 8 s: every attack it starts can be interrupted, and any hit during its wind-up staggers it. Works on elites.

errand.name: Errand
errand.summary: Point, 10 m: the enemy nearest that spot that can see you (or is asleep) walks to it and stands there 2 s without attacking - into your pool, out of the line, away from the Drummer. A hit breaks it.

shutter.name: Shutter
shutter.summary: Point, 10 m: minds within 3.5 m that see it close up: 25, and for 8 s they cannot be Drummed or Roused, and cannot call for help or answer a call.

sting_dart.name: Sting Dart
sting_dart.summary: A fast dart: 50 and 2 doses. The first dose starts a 6 s clock over its head; when it runs out, every dose in the body is paid at once, 20 each.

black_purge.name: Black Purge
black_purge.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow that drives every dose in it through at once - the whole bill now, at half again (30 a dose) - and interrupts.

fouling_slide.name: Fouling Slide
fouling_slide.summary: Slide 5 m straight through enemies, fouling each one you brush: 2 doses each.

clean_air.name: Clean Air
clean_air.summary: Point, 9 m: air 4 m across for 8 s that nothing foul can use. Enemies in it cannot be healed or Frenzied, and a Censer-Bearer that dies inside bursts for nothing.

caustic_spew.name: Caustic Spew
caustic_spew.summary: A spray of acid in front of you, 3.1 m: a solid hit, a dose, and Corroded - each stack takes a third off their armour, shields included.

counterdose.name: Counterdose
counterdose.summary: A dart of counter-agent: 45, and the target's doses are cancelled - no bill - while its body seizes for 0.3 s a dose (2.5 s at most), interrupting whatever it was doing.

residue.name: Residue
residue.summary: Point, 9 m: a slick of residue 3 m across for 10 s. Anything standing in it takes a dose every second. It stays exactly where you put it.

funnel.name: Funnel
funnel.summary: One enemy within 10 m: every other dosed enemy within 6 m of it is flushed clean, and all their doses pour into it - up to 20. Its clock does not change.

sapping_tether.name: Sapping Tether
sapping_tether.summary: Hold on one enemy within 7 m: a thin thread drips a dose into it every half second, and while it holds the target deals 30% less damage and moves 30% slower. You walk at half speed; the thread breaks past 9 m or behind stone.

bitter_tonic.name: Bitter Tonic
bitter_tonic.summary: Drink it: for 8 s you move 15% faster, recover from skills a quarter sooner, and the doses you give come due in 4 s instead of 6.

fever_flask.name: Fever Flask
fever_flask.summary: Lob a flask up to 12 m: it bursts over shields and heads for 45 and 2 Infected, and leaves a sick cloud 2.5 m across that hangs 6 s and drifts slowly away from you.

crisis.name: Crisis
crisis.summary: Every Infected enemy within 10 m has its fever broken at once: 30 a stack, all now, and the stacks are gone. Armour still cuts it.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.summary: One enemy within 9 m catches it (2 Infected); then every enemy within 3 m of it catches it, and every enemy within 3 m of those - up to 8 bodies, 20 and 1 Infected each.

sealing_clot.name: Sealing Clot
sealing_clot.simplified: when Contained ends, the stacks above five do not fall away
sealing_clot.summary: A clot that sticks to one enemy: 45 and 3 Infected, and for 10 s the sickness is sealed in - it can climb to 10 stacks and burns half again as hard, but never leaves that body. (simplified)

festering_hands.name: Festering Hands
festering_hands.summary: For 8 s every hit you land on an Infected enemy - bare strikes too - adds a stack, and its poise stops refilling while the wound festers.

lancing_cut.name: Lancing Cut
lancing_cut.summary: One enemy in reach: a cut that lances its sickness - +25 a stack, the stacks drained - and what drains out hangs around it as a 2.5 m cloud for 5 s.

plaguebloom.name: Plaguebloom
plaguebloom.summary: A sick cloud bursts out of you: everything within 3.5 m takes a blow and 1 Infected, and the cloud stays 6 s, drifting the way you face.

dispersal.name: Dispersal
dispersal.summary: Come apart into fog and gather again 5.5 m away, straight through enemies: each one you pass catches 1 Infected, and a little cloud hangs where you stood for 4 s.

teeming_fog.name: Teeming Fog
teeming_fog.summary: Point, 10 m: a thick fog 5 m across for 8 s, drifting slowly away from you. Flesh in it catches a stack every second, and anything that reaches 5 stacks inside it is overrun: its poise breaks once.

inured_blood.name: Inured Blood
inured_blood.summary: For 8 s you take 5% less damage for each Infected enemy within 8 m, up to 30%. Stand in the sick crowd you made.
